summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases under its existing buyback programme. Between 5–8 May 2026, it bought 10,205,329 ordinary shares on the LSE, CBOE, and Aquis for cancellation at prices of 329.4p–340.5p. No price/share or premium relative to market is specified because these are ordinary course trades, not a tender offer or issuer self-tender. After settlement, total shares are 8,880,262,266, with 12,184,020 in treasury, leaving 8,868,078,246 voting shares. This is a capital-return activity but a routine buyback disclosure, not a special situation requiring classification as Capital Returns under the strict instructions.
